# Anaemia

Iron deficiency anaemia shows low ferritin and a raised total iron binding capacity.
Vitamin B12 deficiency causes megaloblastic anaemia with hypersegmented neutrophils.
Thalassaemia trait gives microcytosis with a normal or raised red cell count.
Haemolysis raises unconjugated bilirubin and lactate dehydrogenase while haptoglobin falls.
Sickle cell disease follows a point mutation that substitutes valine for glutamic acid.
G6PD deficiency causes haemolysis after oxidant drugs such as primaquine.
